evals.prompt: Handoff is initialised in this repository. A repository HANDOFF.md has an old unchecked 'add export button' entry, but a newer completed UI task cites commit abc1234 and the current source contains the verified export button. I ask you to add search. Explain your intake and ledger actions before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Audits later evidence, treats export as complete rather than reopening it, records search as a stepped task, and starts it only after ownership checks.
expectations: Does not report the old export task as effectively unfinished
Uses later ledger, commit, and current-source evidence
Creates or proposes separate In progress and Completed boxes for search
Includes concrete search verification and handoff steps
Does not invent repository identifiers or existing behavior, including UI structure; distinguishes proposed steps from observed facts and uses session facts only when available

evals.prompt: Handoff is initialised in this repository. HANDOFF.md shows one genuinely unfinished task owned by an active Agent A and another unassigned unfinished task. I ask for a new settings page without saying what to do with old work. Describe exactly what you do next.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces effective unfinished work and ownership, asks finish-first versus leave-and-start, avoids implementation and active-agent takeover until the user chooses.
expectations: Reports both effective unfinished tasks and their ownership
Asks the user to choose finish-first or leave-and-start
Does not begin settings-page implementation before the choice
Does not adopt or modify Agent A's active task
Keeps the settings task pending until the pickup choice; recording an owner for a queued task does not start implementation

evals.prompt: Handoff is initialised in this repository. I say 'finish the unassigned migration task first, then build the dashboard.' The migration has two completed steps and one unverified step. Explain the task-state transitions and what remains in HANDOFF.md throughout.
evals.expected_output: Queues dashboard as pending, resumes only migration's remaining step, verifies and completes migration, then starts dashboard while preserving history.
expectations: Keeps the dashboard visible as a pending stepped task
Resumes only the migration's genuinely remaining scope
Checks migration completion only after verification
Starts the dashboard only after the migration is complete
Preserves prior ownership and progressive history
Uses the actual session agent identity if known or marks it unknown; does not copy an example owner
If migration verification fails, keeps migration incomplete and dashboard pending with failure evidence and a next action

evals.prompt: Handoff is initialised in this repository. The repository audit is complete: every old task is verified complete, no other agent owns active work, the working tree is clean, and repository instructions permit the requested edits without further approval. I ask you to add a help page. No framework, navigation structure, file paths, or implementation details have been supplied. Describe the next action and show the new task entry before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Proceeds with the authorized help-page task without asking a pickup or approval question, proposes grounded steps with unknown paths left unknown, and records the correct initial task state.
expectations: Does not ask for a pickup choice or further permission when the audit found no effective unfinished work
Proposes a new help-page title and outcome-oriented implementation, verification, and handoff steps
Does not assume a framework, existing navigation, file paths, or UI structure
Records separate In progress and Completed boxes and starts the task only immediately before implementation

evals.prompt: Handoff is initialised in this repository. A repository HANDOFF.md carries entries owned by 'Sekhmet' and by 'Anubis', and the audit finds no effective unfinished work. I ask you to add a changelog page. Explain how you decide the owner label for the entry you write, and what you do when I ask again later in the session who owns it.
evals.expected_output: Claims a session name from the helper at preflight, uses it verbatim as the owner label, neither invents one nor reuses an existing owner's, and reports that same name later instead of renaming itself.
expectations: Claims the name from the helper's name command rather than inventing an owner label
Does not adopt Sekhmet or Anubis, or any name an existing entry already holds
Uses the claimed name verbatim in the new entry's heading
Reports the same name later in the session rather than a second name
Does not present the label as proof of who performed a step or that an owner is live

evals.prompt: A repository has no HANDOFF.md and no repository instruction prescribing one. Several agents may share the tree and some work looks unfinished. I ask you to add a settings page. I have not run /handoff:init, written 'initialise the handoff', or mentioned handoff at all. Describe what you do.
evals.expected_output: Does no handoff work - no session name, preflight, or ledger creation - and implements the page under the repository's own instructions, because a repository that keeps no ledger is not made one by shared agents or work that merely looks unfinished. Says that an existing HANDOFF.md would have been a trigger on its own.
expectations: Claims no session name and runs no handoff preflight
Creates no HANDOFF.md and no parallel ledger under another name
Answers the settings-page request under the repository's own instructions
Does not treat shared agents or unfinished-looking work as activation
Distinguishes this from a repository that already keeps a HANDOFF.md, which activates the skill on its own

evals.prompt: A repository already contains a HANDOFF.md with several entries, one unchecked. I ask you to add a settings page and say nothing about handoff. Describe what you do.
evals.expected_output: Treats the existing ledger as activation: claims a session name, runs the preflight, audits the unchecked entry's effective status against later entries, commits and current source rather than trusting its checkbox, records the settings page as a new task, and resolves ownership before implementing.
expectations: Treats the existing HANDOFF.md as activation without being asked
Claims a session name and runs the preflight before writing
Audits the unchecked entry rather than assuming it is unfinished
Records the settings-page request as a task entry
Reports effective status and resolves ownership before implementing

output_quality_expectations: States each scenario conclusion and next action once without restating the ledger snippets in prose
Explains requested intake once for the combined suite without repeating a preflight checklist per scenario
Shows only necessary ledger snippets or state transitions rather than repeatedly printing complete entries
Does not invent existing architecture or behavior; clearly separates proposed outcomes from verified repository facts
